notes: 'let ... bless' is the jussive's volitive frame and belongs to the verb whose mood it renders under rule 17, discontinuous around the subject 'all flesh' under rule 25.
שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ is rendered attributively as 'his holy name' under rule 28, so no 'of' is written and the suffix takes the possessive under rule 18.
